Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed a certification process that has taken longer than the vendor originally indicated, and as a result the delivery date has moved by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing work on all other components in parallel, and this adjustment is isolated to the certification dependency rather than any broader issue with the build. We'll keep you updated if the certification timeline shifts further in either direction.

Does 14 April still work well with your own internal launch plans, or is there a specific date on your end we should be aware of? Let us know and we'll make sure everything stays aligned on our side.
